Look for Greenhouse grnhse = re.findall(r'(?:greenhouse|grnh\.se|gh_jid|boards\.greenhouse\.io)[^"\'\s<>]*', html, re.I) if grnhse: print(" Greenhouse references found:", list(set(grnhse))[:5]) # Look for Marketo forms mkto = re.findall(r'(?:munchkin|MktoForms2|formid|marketo)[^"\'\s<>]*', html, re.I) if mkto: print(" Marketo references found:", list(set(mkto))[:5]) # Look for CMS Collections in Webflow wf_items = re.findall(r'class=["\']([^"\']*(?:w-dyn-item|w-dyn-list|w-dyn-items|collection-item|blog-post)[^"\']*)["\']', html) if wf_items: print(f" Webflow Dynamic Collections Detected: {len(wf_items)} elements (Sample classes: {list(set(wf_items))[:4]})") # Look for specific scripts & custom code scripts = re.findall(r']*>(.*?)', html, re.I | re.S) custom_js = [s.strip() for s in scripts if s.strip() and not any(k in s for k in ['archive.org', 'google-analytics', 'gtm'])] if custom_js: print(f" Custom Inline JS Blocks: {len(custom_js)}") for js in custom_js[:2]: print(" Snippet:", js[:150].replace('\n', ' ')) # H1 and H2 h1 = re.findall(r']*>(.*?)', html, re.I | re.S) if h1: print(" H1:", [re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', h).strip() for h in h1]) except Exception as e: print(f" Error fetching {url}: {e}") EOF","Cwd":"/Users/rodneylewis/.gemini/antigravity/brain/fe7a155d-afee-4a93-8fd4-8f5988e7dc37","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Inspecting Carrot subpages, Greenhouse ATS, Marketo forms, and Webflow CMS collections","toolSummary":"Deep Dive Carrot Subpages"}
